utterance: Hi Daniel, can you tell me more about your back pain? What happened on the weekend when you hurt your lower back?
reply: I was lifting a big pot plant in the garden on Saturday and felt a twinge, then I woke up Sunday and could barely get out of bed, so it has been about three days now. It is low down on the left side of my back, and sometimes it goes into my left buttock. It is worse when I bend or get out of a chair, and worse by the evening, but it feels a bit better when I lie still with a heat pack. I have worked from home the last two days, mostly lying on the couch with my laptop, and I can walk around slowly.
